en-US.name: My Helper
en-US.summary: A patient, curious helper that answers questions, tells stories, and practices math and spelling.
en-US.description: My Helper is a private, development-only skill. Say "Alexa, open my helper" and then ask a question, ask for a story, or practice math, spelling, and reading. Every answer is checked before it is spoken. Questions about grown-up topics are always sent back to Mom or Dad instead of being answered. This skill is not published and is not intended for distribution.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my helper why the sky is blue
Alexa, ask my helper to tell me a story about a dragon

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development-only skill on the owner's own account. Not for certification or distribution. Open with "Alexa, open my helper", then speak any question, story request, or math or spelling practice request.
